method: huggingface.co/api/{datasets,models}/<id> (cardData) read live; cards read at https://huggingface.co/datasets/<id>/raw/main/README.md

nvidia/OpenCodeInstruct.generators_note: arXiv:2504.04030 (read 2026-09-30) names only Qwen models for the steps it names and mentions no OpenAI, Anthropic or Google model (zero hits). The Genetic-Instruct instruction-evolution step says 'LLM' without naming it; the framework paper (arXiv:2407.21077) uses Mixtral-8x22B and Qwen models. Residual: that one step's exact model is not named in the OpenCodeInstruct paper.
nvidia/OpenCodeInstruct.seeds: 1.43M instructions from GitHub Python functions (OSS-Instruct style, Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct) and 25,443 TACO algorithmic questions; only domain=generic rows are used here.
nvidia/OpenCodeInstruct.size: 5,000,000 rows (this experiment reads shard 00000 of 00050: 100,000 rows)

bigcode/self-oss-instruct-sc2-exec-filte.verdict: REJECTED for this experiment: licence fine (odc-by), generator StarCoder2-15B, but rows carry no unit tests (response text only), so pass@1 cannot be executed against them

OpenCoder-LLM/opc-sft-stage2.verdict: REJECTED: licence mit, but provenance unclear. The card names no generator model; its evol_instruct part is the open MagicCoder-Evol-Instruct-110k (an OpenAI-model lineage, not re-verified here); the paper (arXiv:2411.04905, read via summary) names Qwen2-72B-Instruct for an educational-synthesis step and says the hqcode seed set was synthesized with GPT-4o-Mini.

ise-uiuc/Magicoder-OSS-Instruct-75K.verdict: REJECTED: the card states the data was generated by gpt-3.5-turbo-1106 (OpenAI) and points to OpenAI's usage policy

Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B.note: Qwen Research licence: research use; commercial use is outside it. Fine for this experiment; any 3B-derived weights must not ship.
